name: AetherBuilder
changelog: New: Template Autosave & Backup Settings in Site Settings (⚙️ Site Tab) — full control over template naming, backup limits, and auto-rotation
New: Customizable Template Name / Prefix — rename current template to easily recognize and organize different designs in the Media Library
New: Auto-Rotation & Pruning Limit in Media Library — set max template backups (1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50). When limit is reached, older template JSON files are automatically cleaned up
UX: Live template backups counter badge in Site Settings showing existing count vs max limit with 1-click manual '🧹 Clean' button
UX: 1-Click '💾 Save Snapshot to Media' and '📁 Browse Templates' directly from Site Settings with instant template loading confirmation
New: Registration Form Image Options now prioritize image sizing — supports Fit / Natural (Max Image Priority), Banner (3:1), and expanded Landscape (16:9)
UX: In Vertical layout, the image occupies up to 85% of the row with near-fit expansion, leaving a compact neat space for caption and radio button
Fix: Critical api.php parse error (missing closing brace) that caused HTTP 500 on all API requests including media library and uploads on shared hosting (InfinityFree / Apache / PHP)
Fix: Media Library now fully loads and displays files on hosted PHP environments (was broken from v2.9.1)
Fix: File uploads now succeed on shared hosting — removed custom X-Admin-Token header from upload fetch to prevent CORS OPTIONS preflight blocks
New: Add-On Studio wizard fully mobile-friendly — prop rows reflow to 2-column card layout, tab bar scrolls horizontally, footer buttons stack vertically
